findings.title: Proposed runtime/permission choices do not satisfy the owner identity brief; production principals and RPCs do not exist
findings.evidence: Owner brief requires dedicated mip_* capability identities, NOLOGIN function owners, EXECUTE-only APIs, and no shared service_role worker credentials. Isolated SQL creates qual_* roles only. runtime-permission-proposal.json alternative_a keeps live workers on unbound service_role. v16 Deno.serve uses Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') and authorizeWriter accepts Bearer serviceKey. qualification schema is recorded absent on live projects. chosen bindings are null.
findings.impact: An isolated passing contract cannot be installed as the production package. Ambient privileged credentials remain the effective runtime authority.
findings.violated_requirement: Owner Decision Brief §§3–4; producer/worker authority PASS condition
findings.proposed_verification: A later production grant/RLS/RPC manifest that names exact mip_* roles, JWT iss/aud/sub, credential custodians, and proves workers cannot SET ROLE service_role or hold SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Do not treat renaming qual_* as sufficient.

findings.title: No frozen semantic acceptance policy, split, or independently adjudicated labels
findings.evidence: evaluation-policy.json status=proposed_not_approved; all measure thresholds null; critical_error_threshold null; minimum_cases null. No corpus, labels, or predictions in the packet. Harness always returns qualification=not_assessed. This reviewer did not invent labels.
findings.impact: Semantic fidelity cannot be scored. Owner PASS is impossible. BLOCKED, not a fitted PASS.
findings.violated_requirement: Owner brief independent evaluation semantic fidelity and PASS criteria; evaluation-policy.json authority that owner must freeze before held-out measurement
findings.proposed_verification: Owner-frozen policy hash, split id-list hash, dual-adjudicated labels with rationales, baseline and candidate predictions for every held-out case, then metrics with numerators/denominators. Extend or map the harness to policy error categories before scoring.

findings.title: Disclosed v16 worker is a mutable rebuild plus broad queue acknowledgement, not the isolated generation contract
findings.evidence: index.ts rebuildProjection deletes current claims/explanations then inserts; acknowledgeProjectionQueue updates all pending source_comparison_enrichment_queue rows to succeeded; buildEventInputs uses separate pagedSelect calls. Isolated capture_source/enqueue/complete are never called. Live Manus is recorded as v15; byte equality vs repo v16 is NOT TESTED.
findings.impact: Qualifying isolated SQL does not qualify the disclosed comparison runtime. Mixed source reads and pending-ack remain the live-style behavior.
findings.violated_requirement: Atomic inputs; durable outputs and acknowledgement; current paginated mutable reads cannot supply that proof (COMPARISON_GENERATION_TRANSACTION doc)
findings.proposed_verification: A worker that only claims a retained generation, writes comparison_qualification.complete, and never acknowledges a sibling pending row. Hash-only compare of live v15 vs repo v16 if owner authorizes private compare.

findings.title: Bound RPC request-id replay acknowledges without binding arguments
findings.evidence: Independent PGlite probe: worker_complete same p_request with output A then B both returned completed; durable output stayed A. producer_enqueue same p_request with a different payload/implementation returned the first generation id.
findings.impact: Durable history is not overwritten, but the RPC reports success for a changed output/payload. That is incorrect acknowledgement at the bound API layer.
findings.violated_requirement: Durable outputs and acknowledgement: a changed output cannot be acknowledged accidentally
findings.proposed_verification: Reject replay unless p_generation, hashes, implementation, and output/payload match the recorded request; add a regression in tests/comparisonCapabilitySeparation.test.mjs.

findings.title: scheduler_claim shares claim() and can hold the worker lease; per-RPC revocation is not principal-wide
findings.evidence: Independent PGlite probe: scheduler obtained lease_token and worker_claim returned null. After revoke_binding(worker_claim), worker_complete still returned completed with the existing lease. Owner brief: existing record-worker revocation does not retroactively cancel a granted lease and must be explicitly evaluated.
findings.impact: A scheduler principal can strand comparison work until expiry. Revoking claim authority does not stop completion. Session revoke on the bound path is stricter and was independently reproduced.
findings.violated_requirement: Producer/worker authority; recovery: after revocation, new protected operations must fail; collector scheduler must not complete or claim comparison work
findings.proposed_verification: Separate scheduler enqueue-cycle from worker claim; principal-wide revoke that covers all RPCs for that principal; tests for revoke-claim-then-complete and scheduler-vs-worker lease isolation.

findings.title: Isolated producer capture is not server-bound; publication is not survivor-gate parity
findings.evidence: producer_enqueue accepts caller p_source, p_payload, p_implementation. capture_source is granted to service_role, not the producer role, and uses synthetic namespace qualification-source. publisher_release checks operating_gates and proposed state only. dependency_hash is sha256 of input/output/implementation/context, not events/membership/articles/claims/explanations/evidence/corrections/nodes/arcs.
findings.impact: Caller-fabricated source/implementation is allowed in the isolated producer API. Isolated publication cannot claim survivor publication predicates remain effective.
findings.violated_requirement: Atomic inputs include every required binding; only designated/evaluated implementation; publication only of independently authorized immutable public payload with survivor gates
findings.proposed_verification: Server-bound source and evaluated package allowlist on producer capture; publication RPC that invokes current survivor predicates; versioned public-closure hash tests.
